name: The Residences at The St. Regis Cap Cana Resort
positioning: Private beachfront and golf-view residences, from penthouses to Golf Terrace homes, within the secure Cap Cana community, with access to the St. Regis resort's dining, spa, pools and private beach
best_for: Families who want a private home with a kids club for ages 4 to 12
Travelers who want residence living with resort dining, spa and beach access

facts.text: The residences sit within the secure community of Cap Cana in the Dominican Republic.
The residences are private homes with beachfront and golf views.
Each residence is designed for indoor-outdoor living.
Cassava is inspired by Dominican and Latin Caribbean cuisine.
Marola Mediterranean Grill serves Mediterranean flavors with panoramic views.
Cielo Mio is a rooftop bar.
Private poolside cabanas are available for a fee.
Children under 4 can join the kids club when accompanied by a parent or guardian.
Pets are welcome, one per room up to 30 lbs, with a non-refundable fee of 250 dollars per stay.
Self parking and valet parking are complimentary.
One of the resort's two wings is for private residences.
The Jack Nicklaus Signature Punta Espada golf course is right next to the St. Regis.

highlights.text: The residences range from expansive penthouses to Golf Terrace homes.
Residents have access to Nina, led by chef Diego Munoz, as well as The St. Regis Spa, pools and a private beach.
The Amber Room was created in partnership with Arturo Fuente and displays rum along its walls.
The complimentary Children's and Teens' Club is designed for children ages 4 to 12.
Kawa is a coffee and chocolate shop celebrating Dominican coffee and cacao.

considerations.text: Stays at The Residences are not eligible to earn or redeem Marriott Bonvoy points.
Punta Cana airport is about 9.2 miles away, and the property does not provide an airport shuttle.
The St. Regis Cap Cana is not an all-inclusive stay.
